notes: Save is now two steps: the click only issues chrome.storage.local.get (if not fresh); the decision (gate vs commit), the read of the form and the update of `current` happen in the callback (popup.js:182-199). Between the two the view is unchanged and nothing prevents another Save click.

gate() clears any running interval before rebuilding stage 1 (popup.js:146-147), so a late second Save callback can only reset the gate to stage 1 (the user loses wait progress); it can no longer orphan a tick.

The gate message is written once in gate() and not touched in stage 2/3, so its height is constant; only the one-line title and the button label change. With class 'last' the yes button (1px border, so 2px taller) is ordered before 'Keep blocking'; the spot of the former yes button is covered by 'Keep blocking' except a 2px strip at its top that falls in the margin between the buttons (popup.html:16,29-33). Derived from the CSS, not rendered.
The wait uses performance.now(). Behaviour across device sleep, and whether a popup can be hidden without being destroyed, is browser-dependent.
If either storage.get callback receives undefined (storage error) `r.settings` throws: Save stays disabled (load) or the click silently does nothing (Save) (popup.js:13-23,186-188).
Hidden controls are display:none and unreachable; stale handlers stay attached.

settle() (popup.js:120-126) is called from show() and when stage 3 unlocks: buttons are dimmed and click-through (pointer-events:none) for ~620 ms; keyboard activation still reaches the handlers, which return while fresh(). Not active on first opening.

Feedback is a single status line: 'Saved' (2 s) or red 'Couldn't save. Try again.' (6 s), one tracked timer (popup.js:101-109). The line lives inside #form, so it is invisible while the gate is shown.
A hide timer started by a previous message is cancelled by the next say(); the earlier 'untracked timer' problem is gone.
mark() compares the parsed form with `current` (order-sensitive) and treats any invalid entry as 'not saved'.
cancel() no longer refills the text box (popup.js:134-140).

The stale-tab check runs once at popup start for the active tab of the current window; tab.url is only visible for hosts in host_permissions (manifest.json:7). Behaviour when the popup itself is the active tab is browser-dependent.
commit(): show('form') now precedes commit in the final-yes handler; a 4 s timer reports failure if the write has not answered, but does not cancel the write.

parseHandles (popup.js:51-63): entries are split on line breaks and commas and trimmed; an optional scheme plus (www.|mobile.)(x|twitter).com/ prefix is removed, then everything from the first / ? #, then a leading @; valid iff 1-15 of [a-z0-9_] and not one of thirteen fixed X path names (popup.js:44-45). A name with a space is one invalid entry. Stored entries that fail these rules are shown with '@' by fill() and therefore reported as invalid; handles equal to a listed path cannot be saved.

notes: unblock() restores muted, autoplay and box inline position from the snapshot; it does not record/restore play state and never calls play() (content.js:140,219-235).

Shared box: if after marking this video 'ok' the box still contains a video[data-xvg=blocked], unblock() returns before touching position, class or overlay (content.js:230). The allowed video then stays hidden under the sibling's cover (content.css:1), and its own snapshot's boxPosition is dropped.
lastOpen lives in the overlay's closure: a rebuilt overlay starts at 0. It is compared with Date.now() (wall clock).
The button acts on box.querySelector('video'): first video currently in the box of creation time (content.js:178).

Overlay listeners are bubble-phase for click, pointerdown/up, touchstart/end, mousedown/up; preventDefault only on click. Capture-phase page listeners, keydown, dblclick, auxclick, contextmenu, wheel are not intercepted (content.js:157-161).
The guard does not unblock and cannot see detached elements (content.js:293-304).
Scans run on the next animation frame or after 250 ms, whichever first; in a hidden tab only the timer fires (subject to browser background-timer throttling).

Notices: 'Can't open this one in a new tab', 'Couldn't open the tab. Tap again.', 'The extension was updated. Reload this page.' (content.js:184-191). A sent tap clears any notice (content.js:185-189); block() additionally lifts the first one when something openable appears (content.js:198-204).

The reply to sendMessage now arrives only after the background has stored the link and created the tab, or failed (background.js:12-15); 'not ok' and a closed channel both lead to the 'Couldn't open the tab' notice (content.js:255).

Follow/unfollow events rewrite `following` on every cached record of that screen name and schedule a scan (content.js:33-45): covered videos of a newly followed author go to V3 (paused), allowed videos of an unfollowed author go to V1.

Small mode is toggled at each block() call from the box height (content.js:197); class changes are not observed, so no extra scan. In small mode the message is hidden except while data-xvg-note is set, when it is shown at 11px (content.css:19-20). Height 0 counts as not small; width is not considered; overflow is clipped (content.css:17). A resize that causes no DOM mutation does not re-run block().

notes: scan() runs at most once per schedule() cycle: both callbacks share `run`, which returns unless pending is true and clears it before scanning (content.js:285). No double scan.

Neither callback is cancelled. A leftover 250 ms timer from cycle N can fire during cycle N+1 and run that cycle's scan before its animation frame (earlier, never twice). Leftover timers die within 250 ms: no unbounded timer growth.

In a hidden tab every scan cycle leaves one frozen requestAnimationFrame callback that cannot fire until the tab is visible; on a constantly mutating page these accumulate (at most one per background-timer tick) and all run as no-ops on the first visible frame.
No per-frame loop is reintroduced: a scan that changes nothing produces no mutation and therefore no new cycle; the leftover callback is a single no-op.

Hidden-tab latency is 250 ms plus browser background-timer throttling (commonly 1 s, possibly far longer after long hiding); browser-dependent. The capture-phase guard is immediate regardless (content.js:293-304).
Nothing schedules a scan at allowOnce.until (content.js:119).
After an extension reload the orphaned script gets no storage events and sendMessage throws (content.js:245).
Records come from a DOM CustomEvent any page-world script can dispatch (content.js:47).
Top frame only (manifest.json:16-21).

xvg:media merge rule: a new record keeps following=true from the previous byMedia record only when the new one says followKnown === false and the screen name is the same; an explicit 'not followed' now wins (content.js:54-55).
The initial storage read tolerates an error by using defaults (content.js:14).

findings.description: [pass 3] Save is asynchronous and gate() neither checks the current state nor clears a running interval. Two overlapping Save reads call gate() twice; if the second callback landed after the stage-1 yes, the old interval would keep running under a rebuilt stage-1 UI, and after a new stage-1 click the orphaned tick would reset shownAt every 250 ms forever (all buttons permanently ignored). Needs a storage callback more than 600 ms late - implausible, but nothing in the code rules it out.
findings.status_reason: gate() clears the interval on entry (popup.js:146-147); a late callback only resets the gate to stage 1.

findings.description: [pass 3] the form is read in the callback, not at the click (edits made in between are saved), and a non-loosening double click issues two reads and two writes.

[pass 3] storage is re-read only at Save. A `next` already inside the gate is committed 15 s later as captured, overwriting whatever another context stored meanwhile (handles removed elsewhere during the wait come back without being named in the gate message).
[pass 3] a failed write is silent: after 'Yes, do it' the form is shown with the unsaved values and neither 'Saved' nor an error appears.

[pass 3] in a shared box the early return in unblock() also skips restoring the box position and drops that video's snapshot; inline 'relative' can remain after all videos are allowed. The allowed video stays invisible while a sibling is blocked.
[pass 3] hidden-tab scans use setTimeout(0) per mutation batch (no frame coalescing); cost is bounded only by the browser's background timer throttling.
findings.status_reason: now a 250 ms timer per cycle (content.js:289).

findings.description: [pass 4]: unfollowing is no longer honoured for media already seen. inject.js always sends following as a boolean, so 'flag omitted' and 'really not followed' are indistinguishable; the handler turns every later following=false into true whenever the previous record for that mediaId had following=true and the same screenName. After an unfollow, that author's already-cached videos stay allowed until the page is reloaded (new media from the author is blocked).
findings.status_reason: 1.4.0: the carry-over applies only when the new record does not state the relation (content.js:55; inject.js:31), and Follow/Unfollow presses are applied directly.

findings.description: [pass 4]: schedule()'s two callbacks are never cancelled. No double scan (shared pending check), but (a) a leftover timer can run the next cycle's scan before its frame, outside requestAnimationFrame; (b) in a hidden tab one frozen frame callback accumulates per scan cycle until the tab is shown.

[pass 4]: the note is set from box.querySelector('video') but cleared from the video block() is processing; with two videos in one box they can disagree, so the notice is cleared on the next scan and re-set on each click. block() also dereferences rec.variants.length unguarded.

[pass 4]: the carried-over follow flag is applied only via byMedia; a record without mediaId, or the first-wins byTweet entry, does not benefit, so the per-post fallback can still disagree with byThumb/byMedia.

[pass 5]: the two failure notices ('Couldn't open the tab. Tap again.', 'The extension was updated. Reload this page.') are never cleared - not even by a later tap that is sent successfully; block() only lifts the 'Can't open this one' text.
findings.status_reason: 1.4.0: a sent tap deletes the note (content.js:185-189).

findings.description: [pass 5]: the background answers {ok:true} before doing anything, so a failed storage write or tab creation is invisible to the page: no tab, no notice, and the 1.5 s guard is armed.
findings.status_reason: 1.4.0: answer sent after tab creation, ok:false on failure (background.js:12-15).

findings.description: [pass 5]: a late failure reply (Ev10) writes its notice into whatever overlay node the closure holds, even if that node was already removed or now belongs to a swapped-in video.

[pass 5]: player error fallback restarts from the beginning (resume not set), leaves dead qualities selectable, and has no handling for stalls or for a storage read that fails (callback throws on r[key]).
findings.status_reason: 1.4.0: stall notice and tolerant storage read added; fallback still restarts from 0 and dead qualities stay listed.

findings.description: [pass 5]: popup storage reads (initial and inside Save) still dereference the result unguarded: on a read error Save stays disabled, or a Save press does nothing.
findings.status_reason: 1.4.0: read errors are reported (popup.js:16-19,187); a read that never answers is still unhandled.

findings.description: [1.4.0 first audit]: in small tiles (.xvg-small) the message element is hidden, so the three failure notices and the author/reason line are never visible; the mode is decided once at overlay creation from clientHeight only.
findings.status_reason: failure notes visible in small mode and mode re-decided per block() (content.js:197; content.css:20); reason line still hidden, width ignored.

findings.description: [1.4.0 first audit]: parseHandles accepts anything shaped like a handle: the words of a display name become separate accounts, and the first path segment of any X link (i, home, ...) is taken as an account. Scheme-less links are rejected although the hint says 'a profile link'.
findings.status_reason: line/comma split, optional scheme, fixed list of refused X paths (popup.js:44-63); list is incomplete and blocks real handles of the same name.

findings.description: [1.4.0 first audit]: stored entries that the new validation rejects are not migrated: fill() renders them with '@', mark() shows 'Not saved yet' on open, and Save refuses everything until they are deleted by hand.

[1.4.0 first audit]: the player's stall timer is not cancelled on error: 'Still loading...' appears 10 s after the last load attempt even under the 'couldn't be loaded' message; it can also appear while an autoplay-refused video simply waits for the user, and its advice about a lower quality is unconditional.
findings.status_reason: failed flag, paused check, conditional wording (player.js:15-18,69-74).

findings.description: [1.4.0 first audit]: the stale-tab banner checks only the active tab of the current window at popup start, is hidden after Reload without checking the result, says 'nothing is blocked' also for a page that outlived an update (where old covers remain), and cannot work when the popup itself is the active tab.

[1.4.0 first audit]: the 4 s give-up reports failure but leaves the write running; a late success overwrites the error with 'Saved' and refills the form (also underneath an open gate). The storage reads have no give-up at all.
findings.status_reason: initial read now has a 4 s give-up (popup.js:11-12); Save's read still has none; late write still flips the message.

findings.description: [1.4.0 first audit]: the follow hook depends on one endpoint name and its screen_name field, treats a pending follow request as followed, and only affects the tab where the button was pressed.
[1.4.0 first audit]: cancel() keeps declined accounts in the box, so any later Save re-opens the gate until they are removed; the tick is forced back even if the user wants to keep that change.
[1.4.0 first audit]: the nudge is a second click listener on the overlay; class xvg-nudge is never removed and no reduced-motion preference is honoured.

NEW (1.4.0 re-audit): the stall notice is suppressed whenever the element is paused, which includes the whole time between a quality change and the new file's metadata; a switch that hangs shows only the spinner.

NEW (1.4.0 re-audit): NOT_ACCOUNTS is a fixed list of thirteen names: other X pages still parse as accounts, real accounts with one of those handles cannot be allowlisted, and such names already stored block every later Save.

NEW (1.4.0 re-audit): small mode follows the box height only when block() runs (DOM mutation, media event, storage change), not on resize; box.clientHeight is read for every blocked video on every scan.
